subject: Integrator Accelerator Ambassador Program - kickoff & curriculum
messages:
From: John Doe <john.doe@brightworks.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightWorks Partnerships <partners@brightworks.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner bootcamp idea: Ambassador program co-delivery

Hi Monica,

Hope you’re well — we’ve been running a small pilot for our Consulting Partners team and seeing great uptake when we co-deliver a short, pragmatic bootcamp for technical leads at integrator firms. The format is two half-day sessions + a short cert exercise.

BrightWorks is interested in exploring a co-branded "Integrator Accelerator Ambassador" program with Redwood: we’d handle outreach/sales enablement and you’d run a technical track focused on inference cost patterns, deployment modes (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), and hands-on tuning labs.

Are you available to do a quick sync later this week? I sketched some high-level objectives below:
- Fast path to first delivery (30–45 days)
- Trainer handbook + slide deck + lab exercises
- Success metrics: partner-certified engineers, first PoC conversions

If this sounds interesting I can loop in Emily (ops) and share the pilot outcomes.

Thanks,
John

--
John Doe
Head of Partner Programs, BrightWorks
john.doe@brightworks.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@brightworks.com>
Cc: BrightWorks Partnerships <partners@brightworks.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner bootcamp idea: Ambassador program co-delivery

Hi John — thanks for the note, this is right in our wheelhouse.

We’ve run similar partner-facing workshops, but haven’t formalized an "ambassador" certification pack. I’d love to pair on a minimal viable syllabus and trainer kit so we can get the first cohort through quickly.

I’m free Thursday 11:00–12:00 PT for a 30m sync. Laura — would you join to capture enablement artifacts and delivery cadence?

Proposed quick agenda for the sync:
1) Goals & success metrics (what does "certified" mean)
2) Candidate audience & prerequisites
3) Curriculum outline + hands-on labs
4) Ops: schedule, seats, materials, cost split
5) Follow-ups & owner assignment

I’ll draft a starter syllabus and share after the call.

Best,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Senior Partner Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partner bootcamp idea: Ambassador program co-delivery

Sounds great — tagging Camila and Sergio for content & delivery ops. A few quick thoughts before Monica shares the draft:

- Target audience: "Solutions Engineers and Senior Consultants" from partners; assume they have basic LLM familiarity (prompting + fine-tuning concepts).
- Cert threshold: complete both half-day sessions + 1 submitted lab that demonstrates model selection and cost optimization recommendations.
- Delivery: virtual first-run (2 x 3-hour blocks) with recorded labs; later offer in-person half-day advanced lab.

Camila — can you scope an initial lab that fits into a 90-minute hands-on window? Sergio — what’s a realistic timeline to assemble trainer notes + slide deck?

Thanks — Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Director, Partner Enablement, Redwood Inference

> Sounds great — tagging Camila and Sergio for content & delivery ops. A few quick thoughts before Monica shares the draft:
>
> - Target audience: "Solutions Engineers and Senior Consultants" from partners; assume they have basic LLM familiarity (prompting + fine-tuning concepts).
> - Cert threshold: complete both half-day sessions + 1 submitted lab that demonstrates model selection and cost optimization recommendations.
> - Delivery: virtual first-run (2 x 3-hour blocks) with recorded labs; later offer in-person half-day advanced lab.

Thanks Laura — I can draft a tight 90-minute lab. Proposed lab outline below:

1) Lab objective (30m): baseline inference cost profile on a small test workload
2) Hands-on (45m): run inference with two model variants, enable batching & KV caching, compare latency/cost tradeoffs
3) Wrap (15m): short questionnaire + submit a one-page recommendation for a partner PoC

I can produce a lab repository (notebooks + sample data) and a short trainer cheat sheet. Timeline: 7 business days to produce first draft materials.

I’ll attach a starter syllabus and a role matrix for trainers in the next email.

— Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Partner Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Partner bootcamp idea: Ambassador program co-delivery

Hi John / Emily — thanks for the quick sync earlier. Per our call attaching a minimal starter pack for review: syllabus, ambassador role matrix, and a draft slide deck. These are intentionally lightweight so we can iterate after the first cohort.

Key decisions we agreed on:
- Format: 2 x 3-hour virtual sessions + 90-minute hands-on lab; certification requires lab submission and a short checklist.
- Timeline: first cohort run week of Nov 30 (allowing ops prep & participant outreach).
- Seats & pricing: BrightWorks handles invites; Redwood provides discounted partner seat pricing for first run (details in the syllabus).
- Ownership: BrightWorks owns outreach; Redwood owns content & trainer delivery.

Next steps:
1) John/Emily: confirm outreach cadence and target list by Oct 29.
2) Camila: finalize lab repo and trainer cheat sheet by Oct 28.
3) Laura: publish enrollment form and track RSVPs.
4) Monica: coordinate final materials + send instructor runbook.

Attachments (stubs):
- RI-accelerator-syllabus-v1.pdf (pdf)
- ambassador-role-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
- kickoff-slide-deck.pptx (pptx)

Looking forward — Monica
